intro: Read the individual rule only when the changed code matches its condition. A rule's priority is a triage hint, not permission to ignore repository policy or invent performance requirements.

rules.when: A useEffect dependency array lists a function that useEffectEvent returns (React 19.2+).
rules.fix: Don't put `useEffectEvent` results in effect deps

rules.when: An effect subscribes a handler prop to an event and lists that handler in its dependency array.
rules.fix: Store event handlers in refs

rules.when: A component effect with an empty dependency array runs app-wide setup, such as an auth check or storage load.
rules.fix: Initialize app once per app load

rules.when: An effect lists a callback prop as a dependency only to call its latest version (React 19.2+ useEffectEvent).
rules.fix: useLatest for stable callback refs

rules.when: A Next.js route handler or Server Action awaits independent operations one after another.
rules.fix: Start promises early, await late in API routes

rules.when: Code awaits a flag or remote value before it checks a cheap synchronous condition in the same branch.
rules.fix: Check cheap sync conditions before awaiting flags or remote values

rules.when: A function awaits a value at the top but an early-return branch does not use that value.
rules.fix: Move await into branches where actually used

rules.when: Code awaits a Promise.all and then awaits a call that needs only one of its results.
rules.fix: Use better-all for partial dependencies

rules.when: Two or more independent awaits run in sequence in one function.
rules.fix: Use Promise.all() for independent operations

rules.when: An async server component awaits data before it returns layout JSX that does not need the data (React Server Components).
rules.fix: Use Suspense to stream content

rules.when: An import() or file-system path comes from a variable or string concatenation instead of a literal path.
rules.fix: Prefer statically analyzable import and file-system paths to avoid broad bundles and traces

rules.when: Code imports from a barrel file, such as an index file or an icon or component library root.
rules.fix: Import directly, avoid barrel files

rules.when: A large module or data file loads at startup but only an optional feature or flag uses it.
rules.fix: Load modules only when feature is activated

rules.when: Code statically imports an analytics, logging, or error-tracking library into the initial client bundle.
rules.fix: Load analytics/logging after hydration

rules.when: A component statically imports a heavy editor, chart, or map library that the first render does not need.
rules.fix: Use next/dynamic for heavy components

rules.when: A lazy-loaded module loads only on click, with no preload on hover, focus, or feature flag.
rules.fix: Preload on hover/focus for perceived speed

rules.when: A hook adds a window or document listener, and many component instances each add their own copy.
rules.fix: Deduplicate global event listeners

rules.when: Code reads or writes localStorage or sessionStorage without a versioned key, minimal fields, or try/catch.
rules.fix: Version and minimize localStorage data

rules.when: Code adds a touch, wheel, or scroll listener without { passive: true } and does not call preventDefault.
rules.fix: Use passive listeners for scroll

rules.when: A client component fetches data in an effect and stores it in state instead of a deduplicating fetch hook.
rules.fix: Use SWR for automatic request deduplication

rules.when: Code reads a layout property, such as offsetWidth or getBoundingClientRect, between style writes on DOM elements.
rules.fix: Group CSS changes via classes or cssText

rules.when: A render or hot loop calls the same pure function, such as slugify or a formatter, with repeated inputs.
rules.fix: Cache function results in module-level Map

rules.when: A hot loop reads the same deep property chain, such as obj.config.settings.value, on each iteration.
rules.fix: Cache object properties in loops

rules.when: Code reads localStorage, sessionStorage, or document.cookie again and again in a hot path without a memory cache.
rules.fix: Cache localStorage/sessionStorage reads

rules.when: Code iterates the same array with several filter or map calls that one loop can replace.
rules.fix: Combine multiple filter/map into one loop

rules.when: A loop or function continues to process items after the result is known.
rules.fix: Return early from functions

rules.when: Code chains .map() and then .filter() to remove empty values that the map returns.
rules.fix: Use flatMap to map and filter in one pass

rules.when: A component or hot function creates a RegExp in its body on each call or render.
rules.fix: Hoist RegExp creation outside loops

rules.when: Code calls .find() on the same array by key inside a loop or another map.
rules.fix: Build Map for repeated lookups

rules.when: Code compares two arrays with sort, join, or JSON.stringify and does not first compare their lengths.
rules.fix: Check array length before expensive comparison

rules.when: Code sorts an array only to take its first or last item as the minimum or maximum.
rules.fix: Use loop for min/max instead of sort

rules.when: A user event handler runs analytics, storage writes, or prefetch work that the user does not wait for.
rules.fix: Defer non-critical work to browser idle time

rules.when: Code calls array.includes() inside a loop or filter for repeated membership checks.
rules.fix: Use Set/Map for O(1) lookups

rules.when: Code calls .sort() directly on a prop, state, or shared array instead of .toSorted() or a copy.
rules.fix: Use toSorted() for immutability

rules.when: A component often hides and shows an expensive subtree and loses its state on each toggle (React 19.2+).
rules.fix: Use Activity component for show/hide

rules.when: Code applies a CSS animation or transform class directly to an svg element instead of a wrapper div.
rules.fix: Animate div wrapper, not SVG element

rules.when: JSX uses value && <Element /> where the value can be 0 or NaN, such as a count or length.
rules.fix: Use ternary, not && for conditionals

rules.when: A component renders a long list of items with map and no virtualization or content-visibility.
rules.fix: Use content-visibility for long lists

rules.when: A component creates static JSX, such as a large SVG or skeleton, that uses no props or state.
rules.fix: Extract static JSX outside components

rules.when: Server-rendered UI reads localStorage or cookies during render, or in an effect that then changes visible state.
rules.fix: Use inline script for client-only data

rules.when: Server-rendered JSX shows a value that differs on server and client, such as a date, locale string, or random ID.
rules.fix: Suppress expected mismatches

rules.when: A page needs an early font, stylesheet, script, or third-party origin but has no preload or preconnect hint.
rules.fix: Use React DOM resource hints for preloading

rules.when: JSX adds a script tag with src and without defer or async, or a next/script without a strategy.
rules.fix: Use defer or async on script tags

rules.when: An inline SVG path or points attribute has coordinates with more than three decimal places.
rules.fix: Reduce SVG coordinate precision

rules.when: A handler sets a manual isLoading state to true before async work and to false after it.
rules.fix: Prefer useTransition for loading state

rules.when: A component subscribes to search params or storage but reads the value only inside a callback.
rules.fix: Don't subscribe to state only used in callbacks

rules.when: A hook dependency array lists a whole object, or a raw number the effect only compares to a threshold.
rules.fix: Use primitive dependencies in effects

rules.when: An effect sets state to a value that the component can calculate from current props or state.
rules.fix: Derive state during render, not effects

rules.when: A component subscribes to a continuous value, such as window width or scroll position, but uses only a boolean.
rules.fix: Subscribe to derived booleans, not raw values

rules.when: A state setter calculates the next value from the current state variable instead of an updater function.
rules.fix: Use functional setState for stable callbacks

rules.when: useState receives an expensive expression, such as a function call, JSON.parse, or storage read, instead of an initializer function.
rules.fix: Pass function to useState for expensive values

rules.when: A memo() component gives an optional object, array, or function prop an inline default value.
rules.fix: Hoist default non-primitive props

rules.when: A component calculates an expensive value or JSX in useMemo before an early return that does not use it.
rules.fix: Extract expensive work into memoized components

rules.when: A user action sets a state flag, and an effect watches that flag to do the side effect.
rules.fix: Put interaction logic in event handlers

rules.when: A component function defines another component, a capitalized function or arrow function, inside its body.
rules.fix: Don't define components inside components

rules.when: useMemo wraps a simple expression that returns a boolean, number, or string.
rules.fix: Avoid memo for simple primitives

rules.when: One useMemo or useEffect does independent tasks that use different dependencies.
rules.fix: Split hooks with independent dependencies

rules.when: A frequent event, such as scroll or resize, sets state for a non-urgent update without startTransition.
rules.fix: Use startTransition for non-urgent updates

rules.when: Text input sets state that drives an expensive filter, search, or chart render in the same component.
rules.fix: Defer expensive renders to keep input responsive

rules.when: A frequent event or timer, such as mousemove or an interval, sets state that render does not use.
rules.fix: Use refs for transient frequent values

rules.when: A Next.js route handler or Server Action awaits logging, analytics, or notification work before it returns.
rules.fix: Use after() for non-blocking operations

rules.when: A Next.js 'use server' function runs a mutation or data read without its own authentication and authorization check.
rules.fix: Authenticate server actions like API routes

rules.when: Server code fetches the same data again in sequential requests and has no cross-request cache.
rules.fix: Use LRU cache for cross-request caching

rules.when: Server code calls the same database, auth, or non-fetch async function more than once per request (React Server Components).
rules.fix: Use React.cache() for per-request deduplication

rules.when: A server component passes an array and a transformed copy, such as filter or toSorted, as client props.
rules.fix: Avoid duplicate serialization in RSC props

rules.when: A route handler or server function reads a static file, font, or template on each request.
rules.fix: Hoist static I/O (fonts, logos) to module level

rules.when: Server-rendered code writes request or user data to a mutable module-level variable (React Server Components or SSR).
rules.fix: Avoid module-level mutable request state in RSC/SSR

rules.when: An async server component awaits data and then renders a child component that also fetches data (React Server Components).
rules.fix: Restructure components to parallelize fetches

rules.when: Code awaits a Promise.all over items, then starts a second Promise.all that fetches nested data for each.
rules.fix: Chain nested fetches per item in Promise.all

rules.when: A server component passes a whole object as a prop to a client component that uses only a few fields.
rules.fix: Minimize data passed to client components
